feeds.title: The Reef-World Foundation Blog
feeds.description: The Reef-World Foundation is a UK charity that has been working to inspire and empower people to act in conserving and sustainably developing coastal resources, particularly coral reefs and related ecosystems. Find out more about their effort and updates from the Reef-world team in their blog.

feeds.title: Reefbites
feeds.description: Reefbites is an ISRS student committee initiative, that was started at the beginning of 2018. The blog is part of the committee's commitment to facilitate education, outreach, and science communication of marine science; providing a platform for early career scientists to share their passions.

feeds.title: Global Coral Reef Alliance
feeds.description: Featuring news articles from GCRA and the latest developments across the world in marine life conservation efforts, the Global Coral Reef Alliance blog is dedicated to the growth and management of coral reefs around the world. GCRA is a coalition of volunteer scientists, divers, environmentalists, and other individuals and organizations, committed to coral reef preservation.

feeds.title: Reef Check Malaysia Blog
feeds.description: Reef Check Malaysia is a blog about Marine biodiversity and Reef Check's efforts to conserve it in Malaysia. Reef Check Malaysia is part of the worldwide Reef Check network. We monitor over 200 coral reefs annually around the country and are actively involved in reef management and conservation efforts.

feeds.title: World Wide Corals Blog
feeds.description: Learn beautiful insight, and tips about corals and other invertebrates found in ocean water and your nearest aquariums at the World Wide Corals Blog. We're a team of driven professionals who are committed to supplying you with the absolute highest quality aqua-cultured live coral. At WWC, our staff takes the worry out of the equation by culturing extremely healthy corals for your hassle-free experience.

feeds.title: Coral Reef Alliance Blog
feeds.description: The Coral Reef Alliance is one of the largest global NGOs focused exclusively on protecting coral reefs. CORAL has used cutting-edge science and community engagement for nearly 30 years to reduce direct threats to reefs and to promote scalable and effective solutions for their protection. Get an inside peek of how the alliance works at their blog.

feeds.title: Reef Builders » Coral
feeds.description: Explore our posts from the Coral category at Reef Builder. The articles cover important information as well as interesting facts on different types of corals. Established in 2004, Reef Builders covers the aquatics industry for keeping saltwater tanks and has been featured in popular media as a trusted source on all things reef.

feeds.title: Unique Corals Blog
feeds.description: Discover coral news, company announcements, latest product updates, Flash sales, and more at our blog. Unique Corals has been transforming how corals are cultivated and distributed from the source to our loyal customers around the country. Our passion shows in the quality of the livestock. We only ship the healthiest specimens and take 'WYSIWYG' very seriously.

feeds.title: Green Fins Blog
feeds.description: The Green Fins initiative aims to protect and conserve coral reefs through environmentally friendly guidelines that promote a sustainable diving and snorkeling industry. Find out about the efforts and steps we take towards achieving sustainability and a green environment in our blog.

feeds.title: 4D-REEF Blog
feeds.description: Our blog dives into the latest research insights provided by our researchers and collaborations with our partner institutes. 4D-Reef is a consortium of international universities and research institutes that provides a quantitative assessment of recent, reef ecosystems, and the interaction with the abiotic environment across gradients of environmental degradation.
